sentences.text:
Author: D.Ramesh
Bench: D.Ramesh
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice D.Ramesh
 Criminal Petition No.3526 of 2020
Order:

This petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 by the petitioner,
who is accused No.3 in Crime No.604 of 2020 on the file of Gooty Police Station, Ananthapur District.
The offences alleged are under sections 269, 272 and 273 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 57 and 58 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Additional Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent.
3. Both the counsel submit that the issue involved in this petition is squarely covered by the order dated 27.08.2018, passed by this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731of 2018 and batch.
4.

In view of the above and in terms of the afore said order, this Criminal petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioner in Crime No.604 of 2020 on the file of Gooty Police Station,
Ananthapur District are hereby quashed.

As a sequel thereto, the miscellaneous petitions, if any,
pending in this criminal petition shall stand closed.
5. The Registry is directed to attach a copy of the order in Criminal Petition No.3731of 2018, dated 27.08.2018 to this order.

JUSTICE D.RAMESH Date: 01.9.2020 YS Kesari Soma Bhupal Rambhupal vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 1 September, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/168467645/
